Name: Prop Hunt
Author: sexynes
Description:
Have you ever wanted to be objectified? 

With Prop Hunt, you can:
[list]
[*]play a game of hide & seek with people you know or don't know 
[*]take a picture of your farm without your hideous face in it 
[*]be what you have always wanted to be 
[/list]
Recommended: 
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7415]Character customization anywhere[/url]﻿ to alternate between props 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url]﻿ to spawn furniture to hide amongst 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2213]Unlimited Players[/url] (might be outdated) 
[*]Use the lightest coloring when customizing 
[*]Play on a furnished save file to hide among your inanimate friends 
[/list]
Issues: 
[list]
[*]Changing eye color in the character customization menu may result in a rectangular-looking figure. To fix this issue, simply change to another shirt in the same menu. 
[*]Wearing a hat may cause the subject to vanish. 
[/list]
Suggested Rules: 
[list]
[*]Must be conspicuous while hiding  
[*]Can not use map, social tab, or other advantages while as seeker 
[*]Everyone has the same viewing distance 
[*]Do not expose other known subjects unless requested 
[*]If not found after 3 in-game hours, players must change subject/location when safe to do so 
[*]Last subject yet to be found may state a hint 
[/list]
